levels.description: Gain Trail Sense: the map reveals which enemy types can be tracked in your current zone.

effects.name: Trail Sense
effects.description: The map lists enemy types available for tracking in your current zone.

levels.description: Unlock Track Quarry: once per day, choose an enemy type in the current unsafe zone and force an encounter with one of them.

effects.name: Track Quarry
effects.description: Once per day on the map, choose a local enemy type and initiate an encounter with one of them. Safe zones have no quarry.
